observations.detail: In shot-0 (0.0-6.3s), two grounded US stickman soldiers hold the 40-ton rubber Sherman tank directly inside all four cupped white palms with continuous tread contact while the centered "NHẸ NHƯ BÔNG?!" card enters cleanly on the paradox beat at 2.75s.

In shot-1 (6.3-9.6s), the workshop soldier, red pump cylinder, and black hose remain firmly planted on the tarp connected to the tank valve while the shoulder-articulated plunger rod pumps smoothly into the barrel, expanding the rubber Sherman beneath a clean "BƠM HƠI!" cloud puff and framed blueprint.

In shot-2 (9.6-14.4s), all three Ghost Army specialists (painter, sound engineer, actor) stand planted on the wooden tent floorboards beneath the indented "ĐẠO QUÂN MA · 1.100 NGHỆ SĨ" heading, with behind-tunic shoulder-articulated arms, white circular hands, and props (brush, boom mic, clapperboard) staying 100% physically joined on every frame.

In shot-3 (14.4-20.5s), both inflatable dummy tanks and the radio mast sit grounded on the upper night ridge with the crescent moon clear on the left, while the half-track speaker truck rolls level along the foreground ridge projecting 20km acoustic waves.

In shot-4 (20.5-23.5s), the person-free Channel map anchors "CALAIS (MỒI NHỬ)" and its defender shields on the French Pas-de-Calais coast and draws a crisp curved terracotta arrow with arrowhead from Dover to Calais clear of "EO BIỂN MANCHE" as the German recon plane crosses the Strait.

In shot-5 (23.5-29.8s), beneath the centered "D-DAY · 06/06/1944" stamp and golden sunrise, Allied Higgins landing craft advance bow-first in the open left blue sea channel well clear of both the surf line and the grounded bluff soldier helmet, while the Allied Invasion Star flag waves flush on the planted wooden flagpole. All 19 single-line Vietnamese captions and the voice/BGM/ambience/SFX mix play cleanly through 29.8s.
Matches b2-colorful-sleep (0.0-3.8s and 16.8-20.0s) in warm paper-grain gouache palette, calm micro-motion, and unbroken arm-to-hand-to-prop contact.

Matches b2-native-portrait-2026-11-13 (0.0-4.8s) in native 9:16 vertical staging, uncluttered upper callouts, grounded foot placement, and compact 72-unit ivory caption pills.

limits: Hashes, decoded artifacts and complete coverage establish current-media provenance, not aesthetic equivalence.
Reviewer identity, independence, actual viewing/listening and capability limitations are declarations, not authenticated facts.
Independent agent review does not imply human approval or user acceptance.
Sample-target review compares the available approved examples, not identical plots, voices, pixels or unavailable originals.

B3 endpoint geometry and authored intentions are diagnostics. Each graphic and motion event still needs actual-MP4 independent review; wrong relationships and meaningless motion cannot receive a limited-capability waiver.

The accepted B2 board contains sampled stills, not motion or sound evidence. Both bundled full public implementations are the available effect targets, not mandatory stories, characters or scene sequences.
